mapper.sql: id, conversation_id, user_id, request_id, input_hash, turn_no, status, created_at, started_at, finished_at, deadline_at, error_code
mapper.select: SELECT FROM conversation_turn WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') AND deadline_at <= clock_timestamp() ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM conversation_turn WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND request_id = #{requestId,typeHandler=com.cooker.conversation.mapper.UuidTypeHandler} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM conversation_turn WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM conversation_turn WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND id = #{turnId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_turn SET status='FAILED', finished_at=clock_timestamp(), error_code='RUNTIME_INTERRUPTED' WHERE id=#{turnId} AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') AND deadline_at <= clock_timestamp()
UPDATE conversation_turn SET status='RUNNING', started_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{turnId} AND status='PENDING' AND deadline_at > clock_timestamp()
UPDATE conversation_turn SET status='SUCCEEDED', finished_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{turnId} AND status='RUNNING' AND deadline_at > clock_timestamp()
UPDATE conversation_turn SET status='FAILED', finished_at=clock_timestamp(), error_code=#{errorCode} WHERE id=#{turnId} AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT clock_timestamp() FROM conversation_turn WHERE id=#{turnId}

SELECT t.id::text AS id, t.conversation_id::text AS conversation_id, t.request_id::text AS request_id, t.turn_no, t.status, t.created_at, t.started_at, t.finished_at, CASE WHEN t.status='FAILED' THEN t.error_code ELSE NULL END AS error_code, CASE WHEN t.status='FAILED' THEN CASE t.error_code WHEN 'RUNTIME_INTERRUPTED' THEN '执行已中断，请重新发起请求' WHEN 'CREDENTIAL_NOT_CONFIGURED' THEN '尚未配置模型凭证' WHEN 'CREDENTIAL_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE' THEN '凭证服务暂时不可用' WHEN 'MODEL_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED' THEN '模型认证失败' WHEN 'MODEL_RATE_LIMITED' THEN '模型服务请求过于频繁' WHEN 'MODEL_TIMEOUT' THEN '模型处理超时' WHEN 'MODEL_UNAVAILABLE' THEN '模型服务暂时不可用' WHEN 'MODEL_INVALID_RESPONSE' THEN '模型返回内容无效' WHEN 'RETRIEVAL_FAILED' THEN '菜谱检索失败' WHEN 'RESOURCE_LIMIT' THEN '请求超过资源限制' ELSE '执行失败，请稍后重试' END ELSE NULL END AS error_message FROM conversation_turn t WHERE t.id=#{turnId} AND t.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND t.user_id=#{userId}
